defs.def: waste food, paper, etc. that you throw away （生活）垃圾；废物

ex.s: It should be noted that none of the items on wastED’s menu was technically made from garbage.
ex.t: 值得注意的是，wastED菜单上的所有菜品严格来说都不是用垃圾制作的。

ex.s: Cao and Wu also collected garbage along the road, in order to promote environmental ___65___ (protect).
ex.t: 曹和吴还沿途收集垃圾，以促进环境保护___65___ (protect)。

ex.s: I was upset to learn that many sea animals eat plastic garbage, ____37____ (think)it is food.
ex.t: 我得知许多海洋动物吃塑料垃圾时感到不安，它们____37____（以为/thinking）那是食物。

ex.s: He builds massive sculptures out of plastic garbage, foreing viewers to re-examine their relationship to single-use plastic products.
ex.t: 这件雕塑由从几次志愿者海滩清洁活动中收集的168,000根吸管制成，首次亮相于越南胡志明市的Estella Place购物中心。

ex.s: Reducing garbage on the beach.
ex.t: 减少海滩上的垃圾。

ex.s: 27.There will still be lots of challenges if we are to _____ garbage in a short time.
ex.t: 27.如果我们要在短时间内___垃圾，仍会有很多挑战。

ex.s: While restaurants ___41___ tons of food each year, much of it remains inaccessible because of ___42___ garbage containers, health regulations, or business policies.
ex.t: 虽然每年餐____41____馆的食品吨数,但由于垃圾容器、卫生条例____42____或商业政策,大部分食品仍然无法进入。

ex.s: 21．（10分）Haze Mabry， who has worked as a school keeper for thirteen years， walks into the school building every day and empties garbage cans， wipes down bathrooms and mops wet messes in the hallways．
ex.t: 21．（10分）Haze Mabry 在学校做了十三年保洁工，每天走进教学楼，清空垃圾桶，擦拭卫生间，拖干走廊上的湿污。

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: His strange habit makes sense when you consider that he’s an environmental scientist who studies how to reduce litter, including things that fall off garbage trucks as they drive down the road.
ex.t: 他奇怪的习惯在你想到他是一位研究如何减少垃圾的环境科学家时就有道理了，包括研究那些在垃圾车沿路行驶时从车上掉落的东西。

ex.s: And while plastic bags may be ugly to look at, they represent a small percentage of all garbage on the ground today.z.x.xk
ex.t: 而且尽管塑料袋看着可能丑，但它们只占如今地面所有垃圾的很小比例。z.x.xk

ex.s: Headaches caused by garbage.
ex.t: 树上挂着的塑料袋。

ex.s: Garbage Collection and Waste Control
ex.t: 作为文化象征而言，美国汽车相当年轻。

ex.s: Take a small garbage bag. ____33_____ This small act will let your neighbors know that you care about the area.
ex.t: 带一个小垃圾袋。____33_____ 这个小举动会让邻居知道你在意这个地方。

ex.s: Their city location also means that they are getting a taste for the multicultural cuisine on offer from the garbage, such as hamburgers, lamb kebabs and even garlic bread!
ex.t: 它们身处城市，也意味着它们开始尝到垃圾中提供的多元文化美食，比如汉堡包、羊肉串甚至蒜香面包！

ex.s: Previously, water quality in the Li River had suffered greatly from an increasing volume of tourists, many of whom frequently threw garbage into the river.
ex.t: 此前，漓江的水质因游客数量的增加而严重恶化，许多游客经常向江中扔垃圾。

ex.s: New rules were also introduced regarding tour boat routes and garbage disposal methods.
ex.t: 关于游船路线和垃圾处理方法也出台了新规定。

ex.s: Soon they found that garbage could be used to feed pigs.
ex.t: 很快他们发现垃圾可以用来喂猪。

ex.s: Garbage from the city was no longer disposed of in the village, and more trees were planted.
ex.t: 城市的垃圾不再被丢弃在村庄里，更多的树木被种植。

ex.s: Steven Stein likes to follow garbage trucks.
ex.t: 史蒂文·斯坦喜欢跟在垃圾车后面。

defs.def: a place or container where waste food, paper, etc. can be placed 垃圾场；垃圾箱；垃圾桶

ex.s: Inside the office, they encourage recycling and waste reduction by limiting garbage cans and avoiding single-use plastic.
ex.t: 在办公室里，他们通过减少垃圾桶、避免使用一次性塑料来鼓励回收利用和减少浪费。

ex.s: It’s jaw-dropping how much perfectly good food is thrown away — from “ugly” (but quite eatable) vegetables rejected by grocers to large amounts of uneaten dishes thrown into restaurant garbage cans.
ex.t: 完美完好的食物被扔掉的数量令人震惊——从杂货商拒绝的"丑陋"（但完全可以食用）的蔬菜到大量被扔进餐厅垃圾桶的剩菜。

ex.s: They saw a man   36    out of a garbage can.
ex.t: 他们看到一个男人____36____从垃圾桶里出来。

defs.def: something stupid or not true 废话；无聊的东西
